proof_summary: Writing \(B_{n-1}=N/D\), the proof first shows that the denominator condition is equivalent to \(n^2\mid Nn+D\).  Faulhaber’s formula and von Staudt–Clausen-type \(p\)-adic denominator valuations then give, prime power by prime power (with even \(n\) handled separately), \(n^2\mid Nn+D\iff n\mid \sum_{k<n}k^{n-1}+1\); this pointwise equivalence makes the two prime-characterization conjectures equivalent.
